hypothesised_pattern: High-residual targets follow the sign of x2*x5 and the magnitude of x4: same-sign x2/x5 with large |x4| gives targets well above the base prediction, and opposite-sign x2/x5 with small |x4| gives targets well below it.
rationale: The four positive-residual rows (targets 0.69-0.78) all have x2*x5 > 0 (about 0.32, 1.23, 2.11, 0.72) and |x4| of at least 1.04. The six negative-residual rows (targets 0.14-0.39) all have x2*x5 < 0 (about -0.7 to -2.7) and |x4| of at most 0.64, so the two terms together separate the groups exactly.
